description: This file defines a ConfigurationException class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the S3 regional endpoint exception namespace. It represents errors related to configuration issues for AWS S3 regional endpoints.

classes.name: ConfigurationException
classes.description: A RuntimeException that indicates a configuration error in AWS S3 regional endpoints.
